title: Topp Leone Generated MBUR and Unit Truncated Lomax Generated MBUR Distributions: New Generalization of the MBUR Distribution
content: Adding new parameters to the baseline distribution using the generated family concept has been one of the most commonly used techniques in recent years. The Median-based Unit Rayleigh (MBUR) is a one-parameter unit distribution. In this paper, the author added another parameter using the Topp_Loene generated family. The new approach not used previously in the literature is to use the Lomax distribution. The author truncated the Lomax distribution to obtain the unit-truncated Lomax distribution and used it as a generator to elaborate the unit-truncated Lomax-generated MBUR distribution. The derivations of the new generalized forms are discussed. The properties of both distributions, including the quantile function and raw moments, are discussed in detail.  The quantile functions can be expressed in a closed form, while the raw moments cannot be expressed in a closed form. Both distributions have bathtub-shaped, J-shaped, and increasing shape hazard rates. Real data analysis is performed to compare the fitness of both distributions.
